description: Monthly US producer price indexes for ammonia and nitrogen fertilizer from the Bureau of Labor Statistics (via FRED): the commodity index for ammonia, nitric acid, ammonium compounds and urea, and the nitrogenous fertilizer manufacturing industry index. Index values, not USD spot prices; US Gulf/Tampa spot quotes are not included. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.
